{
  "dataset_name": "okcupid_stem",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age relative to training mean and std, clipped to bound outliers for linear margin stability.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "numeric_standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth, centered continuous axis amenable to linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((age - 32.9639) / 9.9530, -5.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "height_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized height relative to training mean and std, clipped to dampen extreme values.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "numeric_standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth centered numeric feature for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((height - 68.1368) / 3.9037, -5.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "youth_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Continuous indicator of how young the user is relative to typical adult range (18-69), inversely scaled.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "numeric_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures monotonic relationship between youthfulness and demographic class likelihoods.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((30.0 - age) / 12.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_advancement_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal score of educational attainment: 0=high school or less, 0.25=some college/two-year, 0.5=working on bachelor, 0.75=graduated college, 1.0=graduate/professional degree. Based on the education string content.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses 31-level education category into a monotonic continuous axis useful for a linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "currently_studying_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Continuous indicator of active enrollment based on education string: 1.0 if 'working on' present, 0.5 if 'dropped out', 0.0 if 'graduated' or other completed states.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights enrollment status which is a strong axis differentiating student-like profiles.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "advanced_degree_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Continuous score for advanced technical/professional education: 1.0 if education mentions ph.d/masters/med/law/space camp graduate, 0.5 if working on such, 0.0 otherwise.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Separates highly-credentialed profiles which correlate with technical occupational categories.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "substance_use_composite",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Weighted composite of drinks, drugs, smokes severity. drinks: not at all=0, rarely=0.2, socially=0.4, often=0.7, very often=0.9, desperately=1.0. drugs: never=0, sometimes=0.5, often=1.0. smokes: no=0, trying to quit=0.3, when drinking=0.5, sometimes=0.6, yes=1.0. Average of the three normalized severities.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "lifestyle_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth lifestyle risk axis aggregating correlated behaviors for linear discrimination.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "male_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for male sex, useful as a linear offset feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "categorical_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides direct linear weighting on a strong demographic axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(sex == 'm', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "straight_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for straight orientation as a simple linear feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "categorical_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes orientation axis into linear-friendly form.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(orientation == 'straight', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "sf_tech_hub_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for residence in known Bay Area tech-dense cities (San Francisco, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Berkeley, San Mateo, Sunnyvale, Menlo Park, Redwood City).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "geographic_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures geographic concentration of technical occupations as a linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((location == 'san francisco, california') | (location == 'palo alto, california') | (location == 'mountain view, california') | (location == 'berkeley, california') | (location == 'san mateo, california') | (location == 'sunnyvale, california') | (location == 'menlo park, california') | (location == 'redwood city, california'), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "single_available_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Continuous score reflecting availability: 1.0 for single/available, 0.5 for seeing someone, 0.0 for married/unknown.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "status_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth relationship-status axis correlated with age and demographic class.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((status == 'single') | (status == 'available'), 1.0, np.where(status == 'seeing someone', 0.5, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_education_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between youthfulness and active enrollment proxy via education string containing 'working on', highlighting young students.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a nonlinear-in-raw but linear-friendly product feature that sharpens separation of student-like rows.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((30.0 - age) / 12.0, 0.0, 1.0) * np.where(education.astype(str).str.contains('working on', na=False), 1.0, 0.0)"
    }
  ]
}
